title: Love and algorithms: The future of dating apps, with Liesel Sharabi, PhD

sentences.en: If you're single and looking for love this Valentine's Day, then chances are you're on some dating apps.
sentences.zh: 如果您现在还是单身，并且想在这个情人节寻找真爱，那么您很有可能正在使用某些约会软件。

sentences.en: Over the past two decades, apps and websites have replaced friends, family members, bars, and churches as the most common ways for people to meet a partner.
sentences.zh: 在过去的二十家里，应用软件和网站已经取代了朋友、家庭成员、酒吧和教堂，成为人们结识伴侣最常见的方式。

sentences.en: One study from Stanford University found that in 2022, 55% of all new couples met online.
sentences.zh: 斯坦福大学的一项研究发现，在2022年，所有新情侣中有55%是在网上认识的。

sentences.en: That's up from just under 40% in 2017 and only 22% in 2009.
sentences.zh: 这一比例高于2017年的不到40%以及2009年的仅22%。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, a 2023 Pew Research Center poll found that 3 in 10 U.S.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，皮尤研究中心2023年的一项民意调查发现，在全美各年龄段的

sentences.en: adults of all ages have spent some time on dating websites or apps.
sentences.zh: 成年人中，有十分之三的人在交友网站或软件上花过一些时间。

sentences.en: So how has the shift to online dating changed the way that people meet and form relationships?
sentences.zh: 那么，转向线上交友是如何改变人们相识和建立恋爱关系的方式的呢？

sentences.en: How might the algorithms that power dating apps and filter our potential partners affect who we end up with?
sentences.zh: 驱动约会软件并过滤我们潜在伴侣的算法，又会如何影响我们最终和谁在一起呢？

sentences.en: Do those algorithms do a good job?
sentences.zh: 这些算法做得好吗？

sentences.en: And what happens to relationships that start online?
sentences.zh: 网恋的最终结果又会如何呢？

sentences.en: Are they more or less likely to work out?
sentences.zh: 它们成功的可能性是更高还是更低？

sentences.en: If you're on dating apps right now, what can you do to increase your chances of success?
sentences.zh: 如果您现在正在使用约会软件，您可以做些什么来增加成功的几率？

sentences.en: What are the biggest mistakes that online daters make?
sentences.zh: 网恋者常犯的最大错误是什么？

sentences.en: And finally, how might developing technologies such as artificial intelligence and virtual reality change dating in the future?
sentences.zh: 最后，人工智能和虚拟现实等不断发展的技术可能会在未来如何改变约会？

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, the flagship podcast of the American Psychological Association that examines the links between psychological science and everyday life.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《心理学说话》，这是美国心理学会的旗舰播客，探讨心理学科学与日常生活之间的联系。

sentences.en: I'm Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是金·米尔斯。

sentences.en: My guest today is Dr. Liesel Shirabi.
sentences.zh: 我今天的嘉宾是莉塞尔·希拉比博士。

sentences.en: Dr. Shirabi is an associate professor in the Hugh Downs School of Human Communication at Arizona State University, where she directs the Relationships and Technology Lab.
sentences.zh: 希拉比博士是亚利桑那州立大学休·唐斯人类传播学院的副教授，并在该校指导关系与技术实验室。

sentences.en: Dr. Shirabi's research explores how technology is transforming the ways we meet, date, and fall in love.
sentences.zh: 希拉比博士的研究探讨了技术如何改变我们相识、约会和坠入爱河的方式。

sentences.en: Much of her work centers around online dating sites and mobile dating apps.
sentences.zh: 她的许多工作都围绕着在线交友网站和移动约会软件展开。

sentences.en: She's also interested in the future of dating,
sentences.zh: 她也对约会的未来感兴趣，

sentences.en: including the role of artificial intelligence in facilitating relationships and intimate relationships in augmented and virtual reality.
sentences.zh: 包括人工智能在促进人际关系中的作用，以及增强现实和虚拟现实中的亲密关系。

sentences.en: Dr. Shirabi's research has been published in numerous academic journals and featured by Wired, NPR, Time Magazine, and many other media outlets.
sentences.zh: 希拉比博士的研究已在众多学术期刊上发表，并被《连线》杂志、《全国公共广播电台》、《时代》杂志以及许多其他媒体报道。

sentences.en: Dr. Shirabi, thank you for joining me.
sentences.zh: 希拉比博士，谢谢你接受我的采访。

sentences.en: So happy to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me on.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我参加。

sentences.en: So I just mentioned that there's a study that found that more than half of couples now meet online.
sentences.zh: 我刚才提到，有一项研究发现，现在超过一半的情侣是在网上认识的。

sentences.en: How do you think that's changed the way that people get to know each other and enter relationships?
sentences.zh: 你认为这如何改变了人们相互了解和进入恋爱关系的方式？

sentences.en: I mean, one thing that it's really done is help to expand the dating pool.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它真正做的一件事是帮助扩大了约会池。

sentences.en: So now you're no longer limited just to the people who you might happen to run into going about your day-to-day routine.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你不再仅限于日常生活中碰巧遇到的人。

sentences.en: You have so many more options than you had previously.
sentences.zh: 与以前相比，你有了更多的选择。

sentences.en: And it also means that instead of meeting somebody in person, striking up a conversation,
sentences.zh: 这也意味着，不再是亲自去见某人、搭讪，

sentences.en: you're being introduced to a profile and you're getting to know someone in a very different way in that sense, evaluating them on, you know,
sentences.zh: 而是向你推介一份个人资料，从某种意义上说，你以一种非常不同的方式去了解某人，评估他们的，你知道的，

sentences.en: different types of attributes because you have this two-dimensional profile that is standing in place of the actual person that you would ultimately end up meeting.
sentences.zh: 不同类型的属性，因为这个二维的个人资料取代了你最终会见到的真实的人。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about how most dating apps are working right now.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈大多数约会软件现在是如何运作的。

sentences.en: What's going on behind the scenes when an app is showing you a series of profiles to consider?
sentences.zh: 当一个软件向你展示一系列可供考虑的个人资料时，幕后发生了什么？

sentences.en: How is it, quote unquote, deciding which potential partners to offer you?
sentences.zh: 它是如何，所谓“决定”向你推荐哪些潜在伴侣的？

sentences.en: Well, apps do this in different ways.
sentences.zh: 嗯，软件通过不同的方式做到这一点。

sentences.en: I mean, more recently, they've started to base this primarily on your behaviors.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，最近，它们开始主要根据你的行为来做决定。

sentences.en: So they look at the profiles that you're swiping on to try to get a sense of your taste.
sentences.zh: 所以它们会查看你滑动浏览的个人资料，试图了解你的品味。

sentences.en: And they also look at the types of people who are swiping on you to try to get a sense of who might be interested in you and who would reciprocate if you were to reach out to them.
sentences.zh: 它们还会查看滑动你资料的人的类型，以了解谁可能对你感兴趣，以及如果你主动联系他们，谁会做出回应。

sentences.en: And so they're looking at patterns of swiping behaviors.
sentences.zh: 因此，它们在观察滑动行为的模式。

sentences.en: And specifically, one way that a lot of apps are doing this today is through something called collaborative filtering, where you're swiping on profiles.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，现在很多软件采用的一种方法是通过所谓的协同过滤，也就是你在滑动资料。

sentences.en: And they're also looking at people who appear to be swiping on the same types of people.
sentences.zh: 它们同时也在观察那些似乎在滑动相同类型人群的用户。

sentences.en: So people who seem like they have similar tastes to you.
sentences.zh: 也就是那些看起来和你品味相似的人。

sentences.en: And based on their patterns of behavior, they're making determinations about who you might be interested in seeing next.
sentences.zh: 根据他们的行为模式，它们来决定你接下来可能对谁感兴趣。

sentences.en: And it's kind of similar to how Netflix recommends movies to you, how Amazon recommends products,
sentences.zh: 这有点类似于网飞向你推荐电影、亚马逊向你推荐产品的方式，

sentences.en: where they don't have to know a whole lot about you because they know what people like you typically do, what their taste typically is.
sentences.zh: 它们不需要对你了解太多，因为它们知道像你这样的人通常会做什么，他们的品味通常是什么。

sentences.en: And they're able to use that information to then offer you recommendations.
sentences.zh: 并且它们能够利用这些信息来向你提供推荐。

sentences.en: So all that is to say that these days, apps don't have to ask who you are and what you want.
sentences.zh: 所以，所有这些都是为了说明，如今的软件不需要询问你是谁以及你想要什么。

sentences.en: They can draw these inferences just based on knowing something about how you behave on the platform.
sentences.zh: 它们只需根据了解你在平台上的行为方式，就能做出这些推断。

sentences.en: Are these algorithms doing a good job?
sentences.zh: 这些算法做得好吗？

sentences.en: I mean, how do they compare to, say, a human matchmaker or a friend who says, hey, I know someone you might like?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，与人类媒人或说“嘿，我认识一个人你可能会喜欢”的朋友相比，它们表现如何？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, there isn't a lot of evidence that algorithms are better than humans at trying to decide who you would be interested in.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，没有太多证据表明算法在决定你会对谁感兴趣方面比人类更好。

sentences.en: But that being said,
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，

sentences.en: there is some evidence that believing that an algorithm might know who you would be compatible with can be really powerful in shaping your behaviors in ways that are likely to lead you to more successful outcomes.
sentences.zh: 确实有一些证据表明，相信算法可能知道谁与你兼容，在塑造你的行为方面可以发挥非常强大的作用，从而更有可能带来成功的结局。

sentences.en: So as an example of that,
sentences.zh: 举个例子，

sentences.en: if you're using a dating app where they're doing compatibility matching and they're telling you that the partners that you're being introduced to are really great for you,
sentences.zh: 如果你正在使用一个进行兼容性匹配的约会软件，并且它们告诉你，为你介绍的伴侣真的非常适合你，

sentences.en: really perfect, you might behave differently towards those individuals.
sentences.zh: 真的非常完美，你对这些人的行为可能会有所不同。

sentences.en: So you might feel less uncertain about them.
sentences.zh: 因此，你对他们可能会减少一些不确定性。

sentences.en: You might reveal more about yourself thinking, this person is someone who I'm really going to hit it off with.
sentences.zh: 你可能会更多地透露自己，心想，这个人真的是我会很合得来的人。

sentences.en: But then because you're engaging in those behaviors, it can make it more likely that you're going to have good outcomes if you were to meet them face-to-face,
sentences.zh: 但随后，因为你参与了这些行为，如果你与他们面对面见面，你更有可能获得好的结果，

sentences.en: that your date's going to be more successful because you've already started this process of establishing a very functional relationship.
sentences.zh: 你的约会会更成功，因为你已经开始了建立一个高度功能性关系的过程。

sentences.en: So it's kind of a classic self-fulfilling prophecy.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像一个经典的自我实现的预言。

sentences.en: So even if the algorithms aren't necessarily better than we are at knowing who we're going to be compatible with,
sentences.zh: 因此，即使算法在了解谁与我们兼容方面不一定比我们更好，

sentences.en: the way that we perceive them and how we engage with them can play a role in making us successful.
sentences.zh: 我们对它们的看法以及我们如何与它们互动，都可以在让我们走向成功方面发挥作用。

sentences.en: And is it only compatibility or is it also looking at geographic location or do you have to specify?
sentences.zh: 这仅仅是关于兼容性，还是也会考虑地理位置，或者你必须指定？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So if you're using a dating app, a lot of apps are based on geographic location.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在使用约会软件，许多软件都是基于地理位置的。

sentences.en: So it's showing you people who are nearby and in doing that, they've made this experience more similar to how we've always gotten to know someone face-to-face,
sentences.zh: 所以它会向你展示附近的人，通过这样做，它们使这种体验更类似于我们一直以来面对面了解某人的方式，

sentences.en: which is by looking around us, looking around in our communities, and seeing who we might be interested in.
sentences.zh: 也就是环顾四周，看看我们的社区，看看我们可能会对谁感兴趣。

sentences.en: So they want to make it really easy for people to strike up a conversation and then quickly get off the app and actually go out there and meet somebody and go on a date.
sentences.zh: 因此，它们希望让人们非常容易地开始对话，然后迅速离开软件，真正走到外面去见某人并去约会。

sentences.en: So geographic location plays a role in this, but there are other factors that are playing a role as well,
sentences.zh: 所以地理位置在这其中发挥了作用，但也有其他因素在起作用，

sentences.en: including the types of profiles that you're swiping on and the types of people who are showing an interest in you in return.
sentences.zh: 包括你正在滑动的个人资料类型，以及反过来对你表现出兴趣的人的类型。

sentences.en: Anyone who's used dating apps will tell you that men's and women's experiences tend to be quite different on these platforMs.
sentences.zh: 任何使用过约会软件的人都会告诉你，男性和女性在这些平台上的体验往往截然不同。

sentences.en: Why is that and what are the different problems that men and women generally have to deal with, at least in the context of heterosexual dating?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？至少在异性恋约会的背景下，男性和女性通常要应对的不同问题是什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So on a lot of platforms, there is a gender imbalance where you have more male users and you have fewer female users.
sentences.zh: 所以在许多平台上，存在性别失衡，男性用户较多，而女性用户较少。

sentences.en: And so for people who are looking for heterosexual relationships, this can create some really interesting dynamics.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于寻找异性恋关系的人来说，这可能会产生一些非常有趣的动态。

sentences.en: And you end up with these situations where men are maybe getting fewer matches when they reach out to people.
sentences.zh: 最终你会遇到这样一种情况：男性在联系他人时可能获得的匹配较少。

sentences.en: They're not getting as many responses because women are feeling overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 他们没有得到那么多的回复，因为女性感到不堪重负。

sentences.en: They're getting a lot of attention.
sentences.zh: 她们得到了很多关注。

sentences.en: They have a lot of people competing for their attention on these platforMs.
sentences.zh: 在这些平台上，有很多人在争夺她们的注意力。

sentences.en: And it can be really difficult to keep up with that.
sentences.zh: 要应付这些真的很困难。

sentences.en: And so you create this environment where potentially some people are putting in a lot of work trying to meet somebody, trying to match with people.
sentences.zh: 因此，这就创造了这样一种环境：潜在地，有些人为了试图遇到某人、试图与人匹配，付出了很多努力。

sentences.en: And then other people are getting so much attention that they're overwhelmed and they're just not able to keep up.
sentences.zh: 而另一些人则得到了如此多的关注，以至于他们应接不暇，根本无法跟上。

sentences.en: And so when you look at men and women, they can end up with these fundamentally different experiences on the platform where for some people, it's really expanding their pool.
sentences.zh: 因此，当你审视男性和女性时，他们最终会在平台上获得截然不同的体验：对某些人来说，这确实扩大了他们的社交圈。

sentences.en: They really feel like they have a lot of options.
sentences.zh: 他们真的觉得自己有很多选择。

sentences.en: And for other people, they feel like they're putting in a lot of time and effort, but it's not actually leading them anywhere.
sentences.zh: 而对其他人来说，他们觉得自己投入了大量的时间和精力，但并没有真正带他们去任何地方。

sentences.en: And this is where algorithms can become helpful in trying to make sure that people are being shown profiles of potential partners who are actually going to reciprocate if they were to reach out and who are actually going to be interested because it's a big problem on dating apps.
sentences.zh: 这就是算法可以发挥作用的地方，它们试图确保向人们展示那些如果被联系实际上会做出回应、并且真正会感兴趣的潜在伴侣的个人资料，因为这是约会软件上的一个大问题。

sentences.en: What's the proportion of men to women on most of these apps?
sentences.zh: 大多数这些软件上男女性别的比例是多少？

sentences.en: Do you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: No, I mean, it would really depend on the specific platform that somebody is using.
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，这真的取决于某人使用的具体平台。

sentences.en: And so I don't have any specific numbers in terms of the gender balance.
sentences.zh: 所以在性别平衡方面，我没有任何具体的数字。

sentences.en: Aside from saying that on a lot of them, there does tend to be more male users.
sentences.zh: 除了说在许多平台上，男性用户确实往往更多。

sentences.en: But yeah, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但是是的，我不知道。

sentences.en: Is that something proprietary that the companies don't want to release?
sentences.zh: 这是公司不想公开的某种专有信息吗？

sentences.en: Because if you knew, you might not be playing.
sentences.zh: 因为如果你知道了，你可能就不会玩了。

sentences.en: Yeah, so much of this is proprietary.
sentences.zh: 是的，这里面很大一部分是专有的。

sentences.en: I mean, we can make assumptions, we can make inferences based on, you know, people who are using them,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们可以做出假设，我们可以根据使用它们的人做出推断，

sentences.en: but there's only so much we can know without actually having access to some of that proprietary data.
sentences.zh: 但在无法实际访问其中一些专有数据的情况下，我们能知道的也就只有这么多了。

sentences.en: What about for people who are looking for same-sex partners?
sentences.zh: 那么对于寻找同性伴侣的人来说呢？

sentences.en: Are their experiences different from people who are looking for opposite-sex states?
sentences.zh: 他们的体验与寻找异性约会对象的人有什么不同吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对不同。

sentences.en: And there are also different types of platforms that cater specifically to people who are looking for same-sex partners.
sentences.zh: 而且还有专门迎合寻找同性伴侣的人的不同类型的平台。

sentences.en: So you have the dating apps like Tinder and Hinge and Bumble that cater to a really broad demographic of users.
sentences.zh: 所以你有像Tinder、Hinge和Bumble这样的约会软件，它们迎合了非常广泛的用户群体。

sentences.en: And then you also have these niche dating apps, some of them catering specifically to people who are looking for same-sex relationships.
sentences.zh: 然后你还有这些小众的约会软件，其中一些专门迎合寻找同性关系的人。

sentences.en: So I think about Grindr, which was actually a precursor to apps that we have today, like Tinder, that caters to men who are looking for other men to form relationships with.
sentences.zh: 所以我想到了Grindr，它实际上是我们今天拥有的像Tinder这样的软件的先驱，它迎合了寻找其他男性来建立关系的男性。

sentences.en: You have apps like Her.
sentences.zh: 你有像Her这样的软件。

sentences.en: So there are specific platforms that are designed to facilitate those types of relationships.
sentences.zh: 所以有专门设计的平台来促进这些类型关系的建立。

sentences.en: You've done some research comparing long-term relationships that started online with those that started some other way.
sentences.zh: 你做过一些研究，比较了网上开始的长期关系与通过其他方式开始的长期关系。

sentences.en: What have you found?
sentences.zh: 你发现了什么？

sentences.en: Is there any difference in relationship quality or divorce rate or any other factors?
sentences.zh: 关系质量、离婚率或其他任何因素有什么区别吗？

sentences.en: So 10 years ago, just about 10 years ago,
sentences.zh: 所以在10年前，差不多10年前，

sentences.en: there was a study that came out that compared the marriages of couples that were meeting online to the marriages of couples who were meeting face-to-face.
sentences.zh: 有一项研究问世，它将在线认识的情侣的婚姻与面对面认识的情侣的婚姻进行了比较。

sentences.en: And what they found was that people who were meeting online were a little bit more satisfied in their relationships.
sentences.zh: 他们发现的是，在线认识的人对他们的关系稍微满意一些。

sentences.en: They were a little bit more stable.
sentences.zh: 他们稍微更稳定一些。

sentences.en: And so that was a pretty positive outcome.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个相当积极的结果。

sentences.en: So you would like to think that if you use online dating, maybe that's going to mean that you have a more successful long-term relationship.
sentences.zh: 因此，你会倾向于认为，如果你使用在线约会，也许这意味着你将拥有一个更成功的长期关系。

sentences.en: Not a lot of work has been done in that area since.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该领域没有做太多的工作。

sentences.en: And so recently, my colleague and I actually collected some data to try to see if those effects still hold today.
sentences.zh: 所以最近，我和我的同事实际上收集了一些数据，试图看看这些影响在今天是否依然存在。

sentences.en: So if it is still the case that people who are meeting through online dating are more successful in the long run.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，通过在线约会认识的人从长远来看是否仍然更成功。

sentences.en: And we actually found that the effects were in the opposite direction.
sentences.zh: 而我们实际发现的是，影响却朝着相反的方向发展。

sentences.en: So people who are meeting through online dating were actually a little bit less satisfied in their marriages.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过在线约会认识的人实际上对他们的婚姻稍微不太满意。

sentences.en: They were a little bit less stable, more likely to consider divorce.
sentences.zh: 他们稍微不太稳定，更有可能考虑离婚。

sentences.en: And these aren't big effects by any means.
sentences.zh: 这些绝不是很大的影响。

sentences.en: So these aren't big differences.
sentences.zh: 所以这些不是巨大的差异。

sentences.en: But at the same time, they're noteworthy.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，它们是值得注意的。

sentences.en: And so you might start to think, okay, what could explain that?
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会开始思考，好吧，什么能解释这一点？

sentences.en: What's changed in the past 10 years?
sentences.zh: 过去10年发生了什么变化？

sentences.en: And one of the big changes that's happened is just the shift from online dating sites to mobile dating apps.
sentences.zh: 发生的一个重大变化就是从在线交友网站转向了移动约会软件。

sentences.en: Because we're now about a decade into mobile dating, we're starting to see some of the long-term implications of forming relationships this way.
sentences.zh: 因为我们现在进入移动约会时代大约十年了，我们开始看到以这种方式建立关系的某些长期影响。

sentences.en: And so it's seeming like perhaps that's playing a role in some of the outcomes that people are experiencing.
sentences.zh: 因此，看起来也许这在人们正在经历的一些结果中发挥了作用。

sentences.en: And so then you can think even more about what's different about dating apps in particular.
sentences.zh: 然后你可以更多地思考约会软件到底有什么不同。

sentences.en: But I mean, the matchmaking process is different.
sentences.zh: 但我的意思是，匹配过程是不同的。

sentences.en: The process that people follow to actually initiate a relationship where you're swiping on profiles that are very much centered around photos rather than self-descriptions.
sentences.zh: 人们实际发起关系的后续过程，即你在很大程度上围绕照片而不是自我描述来滑动个人资料。

sentences.en: And then the fact that you're having to go through lots of profiles, you're meeting lots of people, and you just have lots of options.
sentences.zh: 然后是这样一个事实：你必须浏览大量的个人资料，你遇到了很多人，而且你有很多选择。

sentences.en: And so it's easy to go back to the dating pool if something doesn't work out or if somebody doesn't exactly meet your expectations.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果有什么不顺心，或者如果某人不完全符合你的期望，重新回到约会池里是很容易的。

sentences.en: What about the probability of a date turning into marriage, assuming that that's the dater's goal?
sentences.zh: 假设约会者的目标是结婚，那么约会演变成婚姻的概率如何？

sentences.en: How do online matches compare to other types of matches in that realm?
sentences.zh: 在这个领域，网络匹配与其他类型的匹配相比如何？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So the big thing to know about online dating is that not everyone is looking for a committed long-term relationship.
sentences.zh: 所以关于在线约会，需要了解的一件大事是，并不是每个人都在寻找承诺的长期关系。

sentences.en: And I think this is a big source of frustration for a lot of people, especially people who are interested in commitment,
sentences.zh: 我认为这对于许多人来说是一个巨大的沮丧来源，特别是对那些对承诺感兴趣的人来说，

sentences.en: because it can be really hard to figure out what people's goals are and to find people whose goals align with your own.
sentences.zh: 因为弄清楚人们的目标是什么以及找到目标与你一致的人可能会非常困难。

sentences.en: And I think it also, there's this mindset and this attitude that comes up in online dating where people kind of feel like because it's so easy to form relationships,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这也带来了一种心态和态度，这种心态和态度会出现在在线约会中，人们觉得因为建立关系太容易了，

sentences.en: because they have so many options available to them, it can almost start to make relationships feel a little bit disposable.
sentences.zh: 因为他们有太多的选择可供使用，它几乎开始让人觉得关系有点像用完即弃的物品。

sentences.en: In the sense that you might find that you're really hitting it off with someone, but in the back of your mind, you might wonder, okay, is somebody better out there?
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，你可能会发现你和某人真的很合得来，但在你的脑海深处，你可能会想，好吧，外面会不会有更好的人？

sentences.en: If I just keep swiping, is that going to lead me to someone that's even more perfect than the person I'm interacting with right now?
sentences.zh: 如果我继续滑动，会不会带我找到一个比我现在正在与之互动的人更完美的人？

sentences.en: And I compare that to the experience of dating before we had these apps, where if you meet someone,
sentences.zh: 我将其与我们拥有这些软件之前的约会体验进行比较，如果在那里你遇到了某人，

sentences.en: you're only meeting so many people who you might be romantically interested in just going about your day-to-day routine.
sentences.zh: 你只有在进行日常活动时，才会遇到那么多你可能对他们产生浪漫兴趣的人。

sentences.en: So you might give them a chance.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会给他们一个机会。

sentences.en: And even if they're not perfect, you might still sort of put in the work to see if that relationship can go somewhere.
sentences.zh: 即使他们并不完美，你可能还是会付出一些努力，看看这段关系能否有所发展。

sentences.en: But with dating apps,
sentences.zh: 但有了约会软件，

sentences.en: I think that there is this attitude sometimes that it's about finding the perfect person as opposed to building a strong relationship with someone despite their flaws.
sentences.zh: 我认为有时候会有这样一种态度：它的重点是寻找完美的人，而不是抛开缺点去和某人建立牢固的关系。

sentences.en: And so you've got people who spend a whole lot of time swiping and then not, I think,
sentences.zh: 所以有些人在滑屏上花了很多时间，然后我觉，得

sentences.en: enough time actually trying to build a good relationship with one person that they are committed to.
sentences.zh: 并没有花足够的时间去真正尝试和一个他们承诺要在一起的人建立良好的关系。

sentences.en: And there's been a lot written about the tendency of younger generations today to pursue perfection in everything.
sentences.zh: 关于现在年轻一代在所有事情上追求完美的倾向，有很多相关的讨论。

sentences.en: I mean, is that playing a role here?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这在其中起作用吗？

sentences.en: I think that's what I'm hearing you say.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我听到你想表达的意思。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I really think it is.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我真的觉得是这样的。

sentences.en: I think that people spend a lot of time...
sentences.zh: 我觉得人们花了很多时间……

sentences.en: I mean, they go into online dating with this almost wish list and this list of qualities that they're looking for in their perfect partner.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们带着几乎是一份愿望清单的心态进入在线约会，列出了他们在寻找完美伴侣时所看重的品质。

sentences.en: And they spend a lot of time trying to find it.
sentences.zh: 他们花了很多时间试图找到这样的人。

sentences.en: And you can swipe endlessly in order to do that.
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，你可以无休止地滑屏。

sentences.en: And you can find people who are really great.
sentences.zh: 而且你可以找到真的很棒的人。

sentences.en: But if your goal is perfection, you're going to spend a lot of time on the apps and probably less time in relationships because no one is perfect.
sentences.zh: 但如果你的目标是完美，你就会在软件上花很多时间，而花在恋爱关系上的时间可能会很少，因为没有人是完美的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's unrealistic to think that that's going to be the outcome of all of this.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，认为这会是所有这一切的结果是不切实际的。

sentences.en: And so a much, I think, healthier mindset would be finding someone who's interesting to you, someone you're attracted to, who you're willing to put in the work with.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为更健康的思维方式是：找到一个你感兴趣的人，一个你被吸引的人，一个你愿意与之一同付出努力的人。

sentences.en: And I think sometimes with dating apps,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为有时候在使用约会软件时，

sentences.en: people lose sight of that because it's just so easy to meet people now and to evaluate them on qualities that sometimes don't end up mattering in the long run as much as we might think that they would.
sentences.zh: 人们会忽视这一点，因为现在结识他人实在是太容易了，并且可以根据一些品质去评估他们，而这些品质从长远来看，往往不像我们想象的那样重要。

sentences.en: Do you have other advice for people who are on apps that might maximize their chances of success?
sentences.zh: 对于正在使用软件的人，你还有什么建议能最大限度地提高他们的成功几率吗？

sentences.en: I mean, should you limit the amount of time that you spend or how many swipes after 100 people?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你应该限制你花费的时间，或者在看了100个人之后限制滑屏的数量吗？

sentences.en: Should you stop?
sentences.zh: 你应该停下来吗？

sentences.en: I mean, are there tips that you can offer our listeners?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你有什么小建议可以提供给我们的听众吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I think that people sometimes experience choice overload where they're swiping so much that they start to get overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为人们有时会经历选择过载，他们滑屏滑得太多，以至于开始感到不知所措。

sentences.en: And you get to this point where all of the profiles and the faces start to blur together.
sentences.zh: 你会到达这样一个地步：所有的个人资料和面孔开始变得模糊不清。

sentences.en: And I think that's when you know that you've reached your stopping point.
sentences.zh: 我想那就是你知道自己已经到了该停下来的节点的时候。

sentences.en: So it can help to limit how much you're swiping so that you're seriously considering the people in front of you instead of just going through them one by one and ruling them out based on things that,
sentences.zh: 因此，限制滑屏的频率会有所帮助，这样你就会认真对待眼前的人，而不是仅仅把他们逐个划过，然后根据一些，

sentences.en: again, might not matter so much.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，可能并不那么重要的因素将他们排除在外。

sentences.en: I know a lot of people look at things like height, they look at things like what somebody does for a living, they look at their hobbies,
sentences.zh: 我知道很多人会看重身高、职业、爱好之类的东西，

sentences.en: and it can be really easy to see one thing that you don't like and immediately just swipe left, reject it and move on to the next person.
sentences.zh: 而且很容易看到一件你不喜欢的事情就立即向左滑动、拒绝并跳到下一个人。

sentences.en: And so I think it helps to really consider that these are, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，认真思考这些，你知道的，

sentences.en: human beings that are much more complex than what you might be seeing in the profile and to really think through each person as if they were right in front of you,
sentences.zh: 是比你在个人资料中看到的要复杂得多的活生生的人，并真正把每个人都当成他们就站在你面前那样去思考，这会有所帮助，

sentences.en: as opposed to falling into that swiping mindset.
sentences.zh: 而不是陷入那种滑屏的思维方式中。

sentences.en: I also think a lot of these problems can be addressed by getting off the app as well.
sentences.zh: 我还认为，通过卸载软件也可以解决很多这些问题。

sentences.en: So spending more time actually using it the way it was intended, which is to introduce you to people and then letting the actual relationship development part play out offline,
sentences.zh: 所以，花更多的时间真正按照它的初衷去使用它——也就是把你引荐给他人，然后让实际发展关系的部分在现实生活中展开，

sentences.en: as opposed to spending a lot of time messaging back and forth and then meeting and finding that this person maybe wasn't entirely what you expected.
sentences.zh: 而不是花大量时间发消息互发，然后见面却发现这个人可能并不完全是你所期望的那样。

sentences.en: And then you also end up back on the apps and back in the dating pool.
sentences.zh: 最后你又回到了软件上，回到了约会池里。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So speaking of what you expected when you meet somebody, what about safety?
sentences.zh: 那么说到当你遇到某人时你的期望，安全问题呢？

sentences.en: What about the question of making sure that the person you're meeting really is what he or she says they are and that if you do meet that you're not going to be stalked by somebody for the next six months?
sentences.zh: 关于如何确保你遇到的人确实如他或她所说的那样，以及如果你真的去见面了，在接下来的六个月里不会被某人跟踪，这个问题呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I think you always want to make sure that when you're meeting people from dating apps that you're doing that in a public location, that you tell someone where you're going,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为你总是希望确保当你从约会软件上见人时，你是在公共场所进行的，你告诉了某人你要去哪里，

sentences.en: that you're smart about it and that you do try to stay safe because dating apps are designed to introduce you to strangers.
sentences.zh: 你对此要保持明智，并且你确实要努力保持安全，因为约会软件就是为了引荐陌生人给你的。

sentences.en: That's the whole point is to expand your network to introduce you to people who you might not otherwise come into contact with.
sentences.zh: 这就是核心所在——扩大你的社交网络，将你引荐给那些你平时可能不会接触到的人。

sentences.en: And with that does come some safety concerns.
sentences.zh: 随之而来的确实也有一些安全隐患。

sentences.en: I think that also it can help to at least get to know somebody well enough to where you feel comfortable meeting them.
sentences.zh: 我认为，至少对某人有足够的了解，直到你觉得有把握去见他们，这也会有所帮助。

sentences.en: So at least exchanging some messages, maybe even, you know, going on a video date,
sentences.zh: 所以至少要交换一些信息，甚至可能，你知道的，进行一次视频约会，

sentences.en: getting on a phone call with that person so that you can try to vet them a little bit more than you might be able to on the app.
sentences.zh: 与那个人进行一次电话通话，这样你可以比在软件上更能对他们进行一些初步了解。

sentences.en: But at the same time,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，

sentences.en: not waiting so long to where you're falling into this pen pal situation of messaging somebody and building up these big expectations that would be difficult for someone to live up to.
sentences.zh: 又不要等太久，以免陷入这种笔友式的发消息状态，从而建立起很高的期望，让人很难达到。

sentences.en: Did the pandemic have any impact on people's use of dating apps or is it too soon to even say whether we know this?
sentences.zh: 大流行对人们使用约会软件有什么影响吗？还是说现在谈论我们是否了解这一点还为时过早？

sentences.en: During the pandemic, some of the data coming from the platforms themselves shows that there was a big uptick in online dating because people were at home.
sentences.zh: 在大流行期间，来自平台本身的一些数据显示，由于人们都待在家里，在线约会出现了大幅增长。

sentences.en: They weren't able or weren't comfortable going out and meeting people.
sentences.zh: 他们无法或者不愿意出门去结识新朋友。

sentences.en: And so you had people spending more time on the apps and you also had people trying them out who maybe hadn't used them before.
sentences.zh: 因此，有些人在软件上花的时间更多了，也有一些以前可能没用过的人开始尝试它们。

sentences.en: And so in addition to that, something else that we saw happen during the pandemic was that a lot of people started experimenting with video dating because you, you know,
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我们在大流行期间看到的另一件事是，许多人开始尝试视频约会，因为你，你知道的，

sentences.en: didn't want to go out and go on a face to face date with somebody.
sentences.zh: 不想出门去和某人进行面对面的约会。

sentences.en: And so video offered an alternative and kind of the step in between messaging somebody and actually putting in the time, the effort to go meet them in person.
sentences.zh: 因此，视频提供了一种替代方案，某种程度上是介于给某人发消息和真正投入时间、精力去线下见面的中间步骤。

sentences.en: And so video dating, I mean, it's really a throwback to the 80s when video dating services were also kind of popular before we had online dating.
sentences.zh: 所以视频约会，我的意思是，这确实让人回想起20世纪80年代，当时在我们有了在线约会之前，视频约会服务也很受欢迎。

sentences.en: People were going on video dates, a different kind of video date, but we saw this again, we saw platforms rolling out video dating features during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 人们在进行视频约会，一种不同类型的视频约会，但我们再次看到了这一点，我们看到平台在大流行期间推出了视频约会功能。

sentences.en: And I thought that was a really positive step, a step in the right direction, because when you think about safety concerns,
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个非常积极的步骤，是朝着正确方向迈出的一步，因为当你考虑到安全问题时，

sentences.en: like it does let you get to know somebody a little bit better before you meet them.
sentences.zh: 它确实能让你在见面之前更好地了解某人。

sentences.en: And then it also, it's a way of a meeting that requires a little bit less investment.
sentences.zh: 而且它也是一种需要较少投入的见面方式。

sentences.en: So you don't have to leave the house, you don't have to go spend money.
sentences.zh: 所以你不必出门，不必花钱。

sentences.en: And so I think for a lot of people that can be really helpful as a step before meeting in person.
sentences.zh: 因此我认为对很多人来说，作为线下见面之前的一个步骤，这真的很有帮助。

sentences.en: Now, when online dating was new back in the early 2000s, there was some stigma around that people were embarrassed to admit that they had met online.
sentences.zh: 现在，当在线约会在2000年代初刚出现时，围绕它存在一些污名，人们不好意思承认他们是在网上认识的。

sentences.en: Does that stigma persist today or has it become so common that people don't mind saying, yeah, yeah, we met each other on an app?
sentences.zh: 这种污名今天仍然存在，还是说它已经变得如此普遍，以至于人们不介意说“对啊，我们在软件上认识的”？

sentences.en: So something that's been really surprising to me and pretty interesting is that while the stigma has gone away somewhat, it's also become much more platform specific.
sentences.zh: 所以有一件事让我感到非常惊讶，也相当有趣，那就是虽然这种污名在某种程度上已经消失了，但它也变得更加针对特定的平台。

sentences.en: So I think online dating has become so common where it's not as stigmatized as it was in, say, the 90s when people were less familiar with it.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为在线约会已经变得如此普遍，以至于它不像90年代人们对其不那么熟悉时那样带有污名化。

sentences.en: But now we have these stigmas attached to the actual platform that people are using.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们对人们实际使用的具体平台贴上了这些污名。

sentences.en: And this is something that's come up in my research, talking to people who are in long term relationships that they formed online dating,
sentences.zh: 这是我在研究中遇到的情况，我在与那些通过在线约会建立长期关系的人交谈时发现，

sentences.en: where I've had people tell me that they don't actually tell everyone in their network.
sentences.zh: 曾有人告诉我，他们实际上并没有告诉他们社交圈里的所有人。

sentences.en: They don't tell, you know, family members how they met because they're afraid that they're going to be judged for the platform they were using.
sentences.zh: 他们没有告诉，你知道的，家人他们是怎么认识的，因为他们害怕因为自己使用的平台而受到评判。

sentences.en: So if they used an app, they're afraid people will think that they were on there just looking to hook up and looking for something casual.
sentences.zh: 所以如果他们用的是某个软件，他们害怕别人会认为他们去那儿只是为了约炮，寻找随意的关系。

sentences.en: And so there's that kind of stigma that's coming up for people.
sentences.zh: 所以人们身上确实会出现这种污名。

sentences.en: And so I was surprised that when we're in an era where online dating is the primary way that people are meeting in the U.S.,
sentences.zh: 因此我很惊讶，当我们处于一个在线约会是美国人结识的主要方式的时代时，

sentences.en: that there's people that are still making up these cover stories about how they met because they're afraid of the judgment that they're going to receive.
sentences.zh: 居然还有人编造关于他们是如何相识的掩护故事，因为他们害怕自己将遭受的评判。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, it's gotten better in one way, but it's also changed in another where now it's much more about the app that you were using.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，它在某个方面变好了，但在另一方面也变了，现在它更多地取决于你使用的是哪个软件。

sentences.en: You've also studied virtual reality dating.
sentences.zh: 你还研究过虚拟现实约会。

sentences.en: What is a virtual reality date?
sentences.zh: 什么是虚拟现实约会？

sentences.en: And is this something that people are doing in real life or are they just doing it in research labs right now?
sentences.zh: 这是人们在现实生活中正在做的事情，还是他们目前只在研究实验室里这样做？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, right now, I think it's primarily in labs,
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，目前我认为它主要在实验室里，

sentences.en: but we also have some startups that are looking at ways that virtual reality can be come a part of the online dating experience.
sentences.zh: 但我们也有一些初创公司正在寻找让虚拟现实成为在线约会体验一部分的方法。

sentences.en: And so when you think of what a virtual reality date might look like, I would visualize an experience that looks a lot more like meeting face to face.
sentences.zh: 所以当你想象虚拟现实约会可能是什么样子时，我脑海中浮现的体验更像是面对面的相遇。

sentences.en: And this is kind of the irony in all of this, that the more technology advances, the more it takes us back to how we've always dated in person.
sentences.zh: 这就是这一切中的讽刺之处，科技越进步，它就越把我们带回到我们一直以来面对面约会的方式。

sentences.en: So instead of swiping through profiles and messaging people, you might walk up to somebody in a virtual bar and maybe buy them a drink or strike up a conversation.
sentences.zh: 因此，你不是在浏览个人资料和给人们发消息，而可能是走到虚拟酒吧里的某个人面前，请他们喝一杯或者开启一段对话。

sentences.en: And so you're once again meeting people based on proximity, people that are virtually in the same vicinity as you.
sentences.zh: 所以你再次根据距离来结识人，也就是虚拟中离你很近的人。

sentences.en: But you can also benefit from all of the advantages of online dating.
sentences.zh: 但你也可以受益于在线约会的所有优势。

sentences.en: Like you might still have access to somebody's profile when you're having a conversation with them in this virtual environment.
sentences.zh: 就像你在这种虚拟环境中与某人交谈时，你可能仍然可以访问某人的个人资料。

sentences.en: So you get more information, but at the same time, it feels a little bit more organic.
sentences.zh: 所以你获得了更多信息，但与此同时，它感觉更加自然一些。

sentences.en: And something that I think is kind of exciting about this idea of using virtual reality and dating is that you're evaluating people based on what it's like to have a conversation with them,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为关于使用虚拟现实进行约会这个想法，有一点令人兴奋的是，你是根据与他们交谈的感受来评估人们的，

sentences.en: which is very different from how we evaluate people on dating apps.
sentences.zh: 这与我们在约会软件上评估人们的方式截然不同。

sentences.en: So on an app, you're reading a profile, you're evaluating them based on that information.
sentences.zh: 所以在软件上，你在阅读个人资料，并根据这些信息来评估他们。

sentences.en: But when you have a conversation with somebody, you're paying attention to things like, you know, do they make me laugh?
sentences.zh: 但当你与某人交谈时，你会注意到诸如：你知道的，他们能逗我笑吗？

sentences.en: Do I feel like this is a good person?
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一个好人吗？

sentences.en: Do I like how they treat me?
sentences.zh: 我喜欢他们对待我的方式吗？

sentences.en: And it's just not the same kind of information that you're able to get from a profile.
sentences.zh: 这和你从个人资料中能得到的信息完全不同。

sentences.en: And so I think it could be an exciting direction, but I also think it's a bit of a ways away at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这可能是一个令人兴奋的方向，但我也认为目前它还有一段路要走。

sentences.en: So on a VR date, wouldn't you have an avatar and be encountering people's avatars?
sentences.zh: 那么在VR约会上，难道你不会有一个化身，并且会遇到别人的化身吗？

sentences.en: So you're not even really seeing what they're like, but maybe some idealized idea of what they should be.
sentences.zh: 所以你其实并没有真正看到他们是什么样的，而可能只是看到他们应该成为的某种理想化概念。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So isn't this kind of false in that sense?
sentences.zh: 所以从这个意义上说，这难道不是有点虚假吗？

sentences.en: I mean, what happens if you meet in real life and, you know, the person doesn't resemble their avatar at all?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你在现实生活中见面，你知道的，这个人跟他们的化身一点都不像，会发生什么？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so it's, I mean, that will be a tricky thing about it.
sentences.zh: 所以这，我的意思是，这将是其中棘手的一点。

sentences.en: When it comes to avatars, it also gives you a lot more control over how you present yourself.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到化身时，它也给了你更多关于如何展示自己的控制权。

sentences.en: I mean, you can really get creative in terms of what you look like.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在你的外表方面，你真的可以发挥创意。

sentences.en: I mean, in terms of your appearance.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，就你的外表而言。

sentences.en: And so that could lead to more instances of deception and catfishing, or at least more concerns about it.
sentences.zh: 因此，这可能会导致更多的欺骗和“扮假身份”（catfishing）事件，或者至少带来更多的担忧。

sentences.en: But again, it's the early days.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，现在还处于早期阶段。

sentences.en: So we don't really know yet.
sentences.zh: 所以我们实际上还不知道。

sentences.en: Now, as we have been saying, dating apps are really popular right now,
sentences.zh: 现在，正如我们一直所说的那样，约会软件现在非常受欢迎，

sentences.en: but there have been a bunch of trend stories lately about how millennials and Gen Zers are saying that they're sick of them, that they're swearing off online dating,
sentences.zh: 但最近有一堆关于千禧一代和Z世代表示他们已经厌倦了这些软件、发誓不再进行在线约会、

sentences.en: they're deleting their apps.
sentences.zh: 他们正在删除自己的软件的趋势报道。

sentences.en: Do you think that the use of dating apps will continue to grow, or are we reaching a point where people are getting burned out and they want to try something different?
sentences.zh: 你认为约会软件的使用会继续增长，还是我们正到达一个人们开始感到精疲力竭并想尝试不同事物的时间点？

sentences.en: I think that we are in the, in the burnout era for when it comes to dating apps.
sentences.zh: 我认为就约会软件而言，我们正处于倦怠时代。

sentences.en: And when you think about it, there's, we're about 10 years in, like we're starting to see some long-term outcomes for people who have been on them from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细想想，我们已经经历大约10年了，就像我们开始看到那些从一开始就使用它们的人的一些长期结果一样。

sentences.en: And some people, you know, they've been on Tinder for the entire time that Tinder has been available and they haven't been able to find what they're looking for.
sentences.zh: 有些人，你知道的，在Tinder可用的整个时间里一直都在用Tinder，却没能找到他们一直在寻找的东西。

sentences.en: Same goes for some of the other apps where people at this point have been on there from the beginning and they're getting fed up because they're not able to find whatever drew them to the apps in the first place.
sentences.zh: 其他一些软件也是如此，人们在这一点上从一开始就在上面，他们开始感到厌烦，因为他们无法找到最初吸引他们使用这些软件的东西。

sentences.en: And so, I mean, I think it's hard to imagine a future where technology suddenly becomes disconnected from how we date.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我认为很难想象这样一个未来：科技突然与我们的约会方式脱节。

sentences.en: And I think some of it is people potentially romanticizing a time when dating apps didn't exiSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为其中一部分原因是人们可能在将没有约会软件的时代浪漫化。

sentences.en: I mean, when you look at especially Gen Z, they have grown up in an environment where dating apps, social media have always been available to them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你看看Z世代时，他们在一个约会软件和社交媒体对他们来说一直都触手可及的环境中长大。

sentences.en: So the idea of just meeting somebody face-to-face without the help of technology, I mean,
sentences.zh: 所以在没有科技帮助的情况下仅仅面对面地结识某人的想法，我的意思是，

sentences.en: that hasn't been a reality for a lot of people because it's always been a way that they've been able to form relationships.
sentences.zh: 这对许多人来说并不是现实，因为这一直是他们能够建立关系的一种方式。

sentences.en: And so I think some people are, they're kind of nostalgic for that a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为有些人对此有那么一点怀旧。

sentences.en: And I also think they're frustrated with the dating app experience.
sentences.zh: 我也认为他们对约会软件的体验感到沮丧。

sentences.en: I do think that there is change on the horizon when it comes to online dating and especially when I look at AI and how that might start to play a role in this landscape.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为在线约会即将在地平线上迎来变革，尤其是当我看到人工智能以及它如何开始在这个领域发挥作用时。

sentences.en: I think that, you know, we're at a really pivotal moment with online dating.
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道的，我们正处于在线约会的一个真正关键的时刻。

sentences.en: At the same time, I don't think it's going to go away.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我不认为它会消失。

sentences.en: I could see it transforming in the next couple of years, especially because of advances in AI.
sentences.zh: 我可以看到它在未来几年内发生变革，尤其是由于人工智能的进步。

sentences.en: In what ways?
sentences.zh: 在哪些方面？

sentences.en: What do you envision?
sentences.zh: 你有什么设想？

sentences.en: Will we all just create AI dates and, you know,
sentences.zh: 难道我们都会去创造人工智能约会对象，然后，你知道的，

sentences.en: they'll be the people we want and love and we can just make them what we want them to be and fall in love with them and live with them forever?
sentences.zh: 他们会成为我们想要和爱的人，我们可以把他们塑造成我们想要的样子，并与他们坠入爱河，永远和他们生活在一起吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean,
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，

sentences.en: what I'm hoping that future looks like is one where people are relying more on AI for facilitating relationships and less for actually being the relationship partner that they're looking for.
sentences.zh: 我希望未来的样子是：人们更多地依靠人工智能来促成关系，而较少将其作为他们寻找的实际恋爱伴侣。

sentences.en: But people are already like using chat GPT to help them come up with opening lines to help them create their profile.
sentences.zh: 但人们已经在像使用ChatGPT来帮他们想开场白，帮他们创建个人资料了。

sentences.en: So they're already relying on AI as almost a date coach, someone, something to help them be a little bit better in the dating environment.
sentences.zh: 所以他们已经在依赖人工智能，几乎把它当成一个约会教练，一个能帮他们在约会环境中表现得更好一点的东西。

sentences.en: That's a cheat.
sentences.zh: 那是作弊。

sentences.en: That's a big cheat.
sentences.zh: 这是个大作弊。

sentences.en: At opening line, you need AI to tell you how to do that.
sentences.zh: 连开场白，你都需要人工智能来告诉你怎么做。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then you think about, okay, so then what happens when you get off the app, right?
sentences.zh: 然后你试想一下，好吧，那么当你卸载了软件之后会发生什么，对吧？

sentences.en: If you start using AI to help you write all of your messages, eventually, you're going to get to the point where you can't use it anymore.
sentences.zh: 如果你开始使用人工智能来帮你写所有的信息，最终，你会到达一个你不能再使用它的地步。

sentences.en: And you might come across as being very different compared to how you portrayed yourself on the app.
sentences.zh: 而且你给人的感觉可能会与你在软件上塑造自己的方式截然不同。

sentences.en: So I think apps are going to have to figure out exactly how much they want to allow people to rely on AI.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为软件将不得不弄清楚他们究竟想让人们在多大程度上依赖人工智能。

sentences.en: And so I think that's one way that it might play a role.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得这也是它可能发挥作用的一种方式。

sentences.en: And then there's also startups that are experimenting with ways to use AI in matchmaking.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一些初创公司正在试验如何将人工智能用于红娘服务。

sentences.en: And a lot of apps are doing this, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实很多应用程序都在这样做。

sentences.en: But some of their ideas, they get pretty creative.
sentences.zh: 但他们的一些想法变得相当有创意。

sentences.en: I mean, some are talking about having people train AI to represent them and to go on dates for them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有些人甚至在讨论让人们训练人工智能来代表自己，替自己去约会。

sentences.en: So instead of having to swipe on your own, you've now taught an AI to go out and interact on your behalf and to come back with some partners who you might be interested in.
sentences.zh: 所以你不再需要自己去滑动屏幕，而是教会了一个人工智能代你出去互动，并带回一些你可能感兴趣的伴侣。

sentences.en: So, I mean, there's so many different ways that I think these platforms are looking at incorporating AI in the experience.
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我认为这些平台正在探索将人工智能融入体验的各种不同方式。

sentences.en: And I mean, I think it's hard to imagine that this isn't going to play a big role.
sentences.zh: 而且我的意思是，很难想象这不会发挥重大的作用。

sentences.en: It's just a matter of figuring out exactly what is the best way to utilize this to make online dating better for people.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个弄清楚究竟如何最好地利用这一点来让人们的在线约会变得更好的问题。

sentences.en: What got you interested in this line of research?
sentences.zh: 是什么让你对这个研究方向感兴趣的？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm really, really intrigued by the potential of using technology to help people find love and to really, you know,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我真的、真的很着迷于利用技术来帮助人们寻找真爱以及真的，你知道的，

sentences.en: help people make better decisions when it comes to their choice of a romantic partner.
sentences.zh: 帮助人们在选择浪漫伴侣时做出更好的决定。

sentences.en: I think there's so much potential here.
sentences.zh: 我认为这里面有巨大的潜力。

sentences.en: And at the same time, I also think that some people do have really negative experiences when they use technology for dating.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我也认为有些人使用交友软件时确实有非常负面的体验。

sentences.en: It can be really frustrating for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 对很多人来说，这真的很令人沮丧。

sentences.en: And so I think there's a lot of room for improvement.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为还有很大的改进空间。

sentences.en: But I'm really excited about the possibility of how we might use technology to help people facilitate better connections and to have happier, healthier relationships.
sentences.zh: 但我对我们如何利用技术帮助人们建立更好的联系并拥有更幸福、更健康的恋爱关系的各种可能性感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: So what are you working on now?
sentences.zh: 那么你现在在研究什么？

sentences.en: What are your big research projects on the horizon?
sentences.zh: 你接下来的重大研究项目有哪些？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So one study that I'm working on currently is looking at dating app burnout, the experience of burnout over time.
sentences.zh: 所以我目前正在进行的一项研究是关于交友软件倦怠，即随着时间推移产生倦怠感的体验。

sentences.en: Who's most susceptible to it?
sentences.zh: 谁最容易受到这种影响？

sentences.en: Because I think we are at that point where people are feeling frustrated.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为我们正处于这样一个阶段：人们开始感到沮丧。

sentences.en: And so trying to figure out, OK, why is this experience not working for some people?
sentences.zh: 所以我们要去找出，好吧，为什么这种体验对某些人不管用？

sentences.en: Why are some people not successful in finding what they're looking for?
sentences.zh: 为什么有些人无法成功找到他们想要的东西？

sentences.en: Because I've also been looking at long term relationships that come out of online dating and people's success stories.
sentences.zh: 因为我也一直在研究通过网络交友修成正果的长期恋爱关系以及人们的成功故事。

sentences.en: And, you know, they have such different experiences where some people meet the love of their life.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们有着截然不同的体验，有些人遇到了他们一生的挚爱。

sentences.en: I mean, it changes their life.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这改变了他们的人生。

sentences.en: The fact that they used online dating and they found someone they wouldn't otherwise meet.
sentences.zh: 他们使用了在线交友并且找到了他们平时根本遇不到的人这一事实。

sentences.en: And then for other people, they've been on the apps for years and they've spent so much time and money and gotten nowhere.
sentences.zh: 而对于另一些人来说，他们在软件上泡了多年，花了很多时间和金钱，却毫无进展。

sentences.en: And so trying to figure out exactly what makes some people successful in the apps while others really struggle.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要弄清楚究竟是什么让一些人在交友软件上获得成功，而另一些人却举步维艰。

sentences.en: Well, Dr. Shirabi, I want to thank you for joining me today.
sentences.zh: 好的，希拉比博士，我要感谢你今天能来参加节目。

sentences.en: This has been really interesting.
sentences.zh: 这真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: Thanks a lot.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我来。
